description: This file provides API functions to interact with document management endpoints, including upload, list, update metadata, generate download URLs, and delete documents in a business loan applicant portal.

methods.name: uploadDocument
methods.description: Uploads a supporting document, optionally linked to a loan draft, with additional metadata.

methods.name: listDocuments
methods.description: Retrieves a list of supporting documents for the current user, optionally filtered by loan draft ID.

methods.name: updateDocumentMetadata
methods.description: Replaces the metadata JSON string of a specified document.

methods.name: getDocumentDownloadUrl
methods.description: Constructs a URL to download a specific document.
